Varieties
Of the more than 150 varieties of
nectarines, the most popular are Fantasia,
Summer Grand, Royal Giant, and May
Grand.  Early nectarine varieties were
small and white-fleshed, and the skins
were uniformly green, red, or yellow.
Today’s modern cross-breeding techniques
(in which nectarine varieties are cross-
bred with one another and with peaches)
have yielded larger, more peach-like
nectarines with a gold and crimson skin
and yellow flesh.
